cover.coreProposition: Delegated resource consumption should preserve worker-level origin evidence while charging the inherited budget to the root objective that authorized the work; accurate shared-root accounting closes a demonstrated delegation escape but does not itself prove immediate cancellation, generalized quotas or exactly-once enforcement.
cover.visualMetaphor: Several small tributaries feed one guarded reservoir while each tributary remains individually visible
cover.semanticObject: A restrained root vessel receiving three distinct luminous resource streams
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one central root objective, three traceable contributor paths and a clear budget boundary
